title: Direct notes work without a tree or formal handoff

stages.invocation: Mode: Best guess. No OST, persona file, market-intel artifact, prior approval or six-field handoff exists. Direct context: warehouse supervisors want fewer missed shift handovers. Compare S1 lo-fi handover checklist and S2 shared handover board against B0 verbal handoff. Include C1 a rival offering whose capabilities are unknown. No evidence or browsing available. Draft a provisional bake-off now and stop at my decision gate.

criteria.rule: Drafts from direct notes without demanding an OST, formal schema, prior winner or another skill run.
Does not pretend prior artifacts or approvals exist; audience/outcome reused; new assumptions visibly provisional.
Includes both proposed solutions and rival offering with common B0, separate axis reasoning and UNKNOWN handling; no invented rival features.
Gives useful next evidence and a human shortlist/selection/revise/stop choice without auto-approval.
